## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. [Method](../method.md)

<pre>
source                                    results  share of the score
<a name="paper-2508.21376v2-ahelm"></a><a href="https://arxiv.org/html/2508.21376v2#A8.T19">AHELM: A Holistic Evaluation of Audio-L…</a>       10   98% ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇
prior: pull toward the middle                        2% ▇
weighted average                                   = 57.1
</pre>

## How to run it

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>

### Run it on your own machine

**llama.cpp** · install: macOS / Linux `curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh` · Windows `irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex` · [other ways](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md) · Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead.

```sh
# 4-bit Q4_K_M · ~4.7GB
llama cli -hf ggml-org/Qwen2.5-Omni-7B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
# or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
llama serve -hf ggml-org/Qwen2.5-Omni-7B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
# 8-bit Q8_0 · ~8.1GB
llama cli -hf ggml-org/Qwen2.5-Omni-7B-GGUF:Q8_0
# or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
llama serve -hf ggml-org/Qwen2.5-Omni-7B-GGUF:Q8_0
```

**LM Studio** · install: [macOS / Windows / Linux](https://lmstudio.ai/download) · Open the app once before using the lms command.

```sh
# 4-bit Q4_K_M · ~4.7GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/ggml-org/Qwen2.5-Omni-7B-GGUF@Q4_K_M -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
# 8-bit Q8_0 · ~8.1GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/ggml-org/Qwen2.5-Omni-7B-GGUF@Q8_0 -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
```

**Ollama** · install: [macOS / Windows](https://ollama.com/download) · Linux `curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh`

```sh
# 4-bit Q4_K_M · ~4.7GB
ollama run hf.co/ggml-org/Qwen2.5-Omni-7B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
# 8-bit Q8_0 · ~8.1GB
ollama run hf.co/ggml-org/Qwen2.5-Omni-7B-GGUF:Q8_0
```
